environment.bridgeMode: graphical window, --accessibility always, in-process NSAccessibility inspector (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES)

scope.headless: Metadata only: the semantic descriptor the host resolved, the properties set on each Control and the host path of the OS's press. No OS accessibility tree exists in a headless run.
scope.bridge: The real NSAccessibility tree the window serves to the system, read from inside the process, and AXPress (accessibilityPerformPress). No screen reader's speech, no external AXUIElement client, no other platform.
notCertified: iOS and Android (Godot 4.7.2 has no accessibility bridge there)

hosts.previousMeaning: The host built from main (e88b5bb) before the accessible View, preserved before any C++ changed

example.extendedValidation: After review, on the tree merged with main's device services slice (585ca1b): the press on the disabled Send and on the hidden decoration is observed on the host's counters (one more request, ignored, no click or tap), and on React's Send handler for Send; choosing another rating after the send clears the sent state.

limitations: The headless suite proves metadata only; the OS tree is proved by the bridge test, which runs locally on a graphical macOS session and is not part of hosted CI.

expanded and busy are published to Godot and carried by the descriptor, but AccessKit's macOS adapter does not serve them, so the bridge test does not cover them. selected is served for list items and options (a tab shows it as the radio value).
Godot 4.7.2 has no accessibility bridge on iOS or Android: a blocker for GF-34 and GF-35.

AccessibilityInfo (settings and events), text scale, focus and keyboard navigation, announcements, custom actions, grouping under accessible, Text, the host's Button and TextInput and the Switch are outside this slice.
No screen reader's speech was heard; only the tree a screen reader reads.
Hosted CI has not run the headless step yet, and the bridge is local only. Only the slice checkpoint of GF-20's first slice closes; no whole GF, other checkpoint, weight or denominator closes.
